explanation: A prophet in the Old Testament who delivered God's message to the people of Israel.
A title used to refer to God, the almighty Creator.
The name of the biblical people and land with whom God had a special relationship.
An expression referring to the descendants of Jacob, also known as the twelve tribes of Israel.
Symbolize the results or consequences of actions and decisions.
Those who oppose or work against God's plan and his people.
A symbol of evil and temptation, often associated with Satan.
Means vineyard in English, and symbolizes God's care and protection of his people.
The consequences that follow from breaking God's commands and going against his will.
God's act to save people from sin and death through faith and repentance.
